'''''Opuntia cochenillifera''''' is a species of [[cactus]] in the subfamily [[Opuntioideae]]. It may have been [[endemic]] to [[Mexico]], but has been widely [[introduced species|introduced]].<ref name=iucnredlist/><ref>{{Cite book |last=Gamble |first=J. S. |url=https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/18725170 |title=Flora of the Presidency of Madras |last2=Gamble |first2=J. S. |date=1915 |publisher=West, Newman and Adlard |page=548 |volume=1 |location=London}}</ref> The first description was in 1753 by [[Carl Linnaeus]] as ''Cactus cochenillifer''. [[Philip Miller]] renamed it as ''Opuntia cochenillifera'' in 1768. 

==Ecology==
Unlike most ''[[Opuntia]]'' species, ''O. cochenillifera'' is pollinated by [[hummingbird]]s.<ref>J.A. Reyes-Agüero, J.R. Aguirre R., A. Valiente-Banuet (2006) Reproductive biology of ''Opuntia'': A review. ''Journal of Arid Environments'' 64(4):549-585. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jaridenv.2005.06.018</ref><ref>[https://fsus.ncbg.unc.edu/main.php?pg=show-taxon.php&taxonid=20359 Flora of the Southeastern United States]</ref>
